name: ca-foundation-qa
title: CA Foundation — Quantitative Aptitude (Paper 3)
id_namespace_note: This profile covers Paper 3 Quantitative Aptitude only. A future ca-foundation-be profile will own the caf_be namespace for Paper 4 Business Economics.
assets_note: Diagrams and images are disabled for v1. The Core retains the asset machinery for future exams that need it.

v1_scope.intent: Cover the entire Paper 3 Quantitative Aptitude taxonomy. The ICAI sample paper (May 2025) confirms every item is text and numeric, so no family needs diagram or image assets and v1 keeps assets disabled.
v1_scope.scope_note: Earlier drafts deferred calculus, direction tests, seating, and graphical statistics for assumed notation or asset needs. The ICAI sample paper refutes that: direction and seating items are text word-problems, graphical-statistics items test properties rather than chart-reading, and calculus is text notation (business and economics applications only, excluding trigonometric). All families are in scope with assets disabled.
v1_scope.resolved: v1 covers the full in-scope taxonomy across Business Mathematics, Logical Reasoning, and Statistics. The first content pilot samples across all three parts, not one part only.
